title: Retractable Hooks and Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade tight spaces with a wall mount retractable hook that pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then pushes back in to stay out of the way.

  • Space-saving retractable design: Pull-out rod gives 2-1/2" hanging space for coats, robes, and towels.
  • Traditional styling: A refined fit for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.
  • Solid brass construction: Crafted for enduring use in wall-mounted bathroom accessory applications.
  • 15 lb capacity: Can hold up to 15 pounds when installed as directed.
  • Customizable knob tip: Option to remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob.

Specs

  • Dimensions: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L
  • Projection: 1"
  • Hanging space (extended): 2-1/2"
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount (fits standard interior walls)
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Product weight: 1 lb
  • Assembly required: No

Installation

  • Drilling required: 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
  • Mounting hardware included (6/32 toggles)

Finish options

Available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors, to coordinate with heritage bathroom fixtures and other wall mount accessories.

_previous.title: Traditional Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
